metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Bol Bol Rani
metas.description: Aabhas a journalist arrives in village to cover a chilling story. He finds about Maya whose arrested for killing her husband but everyone fears talking about her. He first meets Ravdya a drunkard who tells that Maya was caged and tortured by her husband, then her neighbor Gandha revels Maya was fast forward girl living with a caring husband but she cheated on him for her boyfriend and was addicted to drugs. Finally a village driver tells Maya and her husband were living happily as perfect couple. But things changed when her past lover arrived back in her life. All three people have different versions of their stories with one common link that Maya possibly killed her husband
